texts: Welcome back. Today we have three experiments and an announcement about next week.
Repeated charging causes chemical reactions inside the electrodes. Active lithium becomes trapped, so an aging phone cell stores less energy with every cycle.
Avoid leaving the device in a hot car. Heat accelerates degradation even when you are not using the phone.
We are collecting wood and looking for food before nightfall. Somebody forgot to bring a bed.
Put it right there. That trap needs a clean, solid floor. Place the pressure plate on the gold blocks and hide the sticky pistons underneath.
Everyone jumped into the water when the creeper exploded. We lost all the diamonds and had to start mining again.
Pack your rechargeable lunch box with a sandwich and some fruit. The recipe uses bread, tomatoes and sliced cheese.
Today we are painting a yellow picnic table. Give the first coat plenty of time to dry before you sit down.
The event horizon is the boundary beyond which light cannot escape. Nothing can send a signal back out after crossing it.
Tidal forces stretch an astronaut lengthwise while squeezing sideways. This extreme stretching is often called spaghettification.
Hawking radiation allows black holes to lose mass very slowly through quantum effects near the horizon.
Rinse the car before touching the paint. Use a clean microfiber mitt and a separate bucket for dirty water to avoid scratches.
Dry the windows with a fresh towel. Never put household dish soap directly on the paint.
Carbon dioxide can be captured from air and injected into basalt. The gas reacts with minerals and becomes solid carbonate rock.
Trees absorb carbon while growing. Cutting a forest down releases stored carbon and changes the local ecosystem.
Whisk eggs and grated pecorino in a bowl. Turn off the heat before mixing the egg sauce into hot pasta so it does not scramble.
Save a cup of starchy cooking water. Add a small amount to loosen the sauce until it becomes glossy.
A state update schedules a render. Reading the state immediately after setting it still shows the value from the current render.
Return a cleanup function from useEffect to remove the event listener. Otherwise reopening the component attaches another duplicate listener.
Choose the loader version matching your game. Put the downloaded mod jar into the mods folder and install Fabric API if the mod requires it.
If the game crashes, check that every mod supports the same Minecraft version. A file meant for Forge does not work with this loader.
Wash the cotton fabric before cutting it. Press the seam allowance flat and keep the grain line straight.
Losing hydraulic pressure makes it difficult to move the control surfaces. Some aircraft have redundant pumps or a mechanical backup for the flight controls.
The secret item is called the Zyphron orb. Combine it with the purple key to open the locked chamber under the bridge.
At Café Lumière we grind coffee just before brewing. The burr grinder produces more evenly sized particles than a blade grinder.
Why ancient Roman concrete survives under seawater. History Archive

Every time you charge a lithium cell a thin film called the solid electrolyte interphase grows on the graphite anode. That layer consumes lithium, so the battery slowly loses capacity.
Batteries also age while sitting on a shelf. This calendar aging depends on temperature and on how full the cell is kept, even if you never use it.
Manufacturers usually call a battery worn out when it holds eighty percent of its original capacity. Below that point the decline often speeds up.
Turn on optimized charging. The phone learns your routine and waits at eighty percent overnight, finishing the charge just before your alarm goes off.
Heat is the biggest enemy of your battery. Never leave your phone on the dashboard of a hot car or charge it under a pillow.
You do not need to drain the battery to zero anymore. Keeping it between twenty and eighty percent is gentler than full cycles.
Electric cars pump liquid coolant through plates under the battery pack. Keeping the cells near room temperature is the main reason pack degradation stays low.
Many newer models use lithium iron phosphate cells. LFP stores a bit less energy but survives thousands more charge cycles than nickel based chemistry.
After ten years most packs still keep around eighty five percent of their range, and warranties usually cover eight years.
The event horizon is the point of no return. Once you cross it, every path forward in space leads toward the center.
Near a small black hole the pull on your feet is much stronger than on your head. You get stretched like a noodle, which astronomers call spaghettification.
Strangely, an astronaut falling into a supermassive black hole could cross the horizon without feeling anything special at all.
No single telescope is big enough, so radio dishes from Hawaii to the South Pole observed together and acted like one telescope the size of the Earth.
The first picture showed the black hole in the galaxy M87. Three years later the team imaged Sagittarius A star at the center of our own Milky Way.
The bright orange ring is hot gas swirling around the black hole, and the dark center is its shadow against that glowing material.
Stephen Hawking showed that black holes should glow faintly because of quantum effects near the horizon. This Hawking radiation carries energy away.
Losing energy means losing mass, so given an unimaginably long time a black hole evaporates completely and disappears.
If the black hole vanishes, what happens to the information about everything that fell in? Physicists call this the information paradox.
Place an observer facing the sugar cane. When the cane grows to the third block the observer fires and the piston breaks it.
Run hoppers under the farm so the broken cane flows into a chest. Each module only needs one observer and one piston.
This farm works best when you stay nearby, because crops only grow in loaded chunks around the player.
Iron golems spawn when villagers feel threatened. Put three villagers in beds and keep a zombie nearby so they panic.
The golems spawn on the platform and walk into the lava blade, which kills them and drops iron ingots into hoppers.
Name the zombie with a name tag or it will despawn and the villagers will stop spawning golems.
This two by two door uses sticky pistons that pull the blocks back into the wall, so the entrance looks like a solid wall.
Hide the pressure plate under a carpet in front of the door so guests do not notice the trigger.
If the door gets stuck, check the redstone repeater delay. The top pistons need to fire one tick after the bottom ones.
Mix equal weights of flour and water in a jar. For the first week discard half and feed the starter every day at the same time.
A healthy starter doubles within six hours of feeding and smells pleasantly sour, a bit like yogurt.
If a grey liquid called hooch forms on top, the starter is hungry. Pour it off and feed it more often.
Pre shape the dough into a loose round, rest it for twenty minutes, then shape it tightly to build surface tension.
Score the loaf with a razor blade at a shallow angle. That cut controls where the bread opens and creates the ear.
Bake in a preheated dutch oven with the lid on. The trapped steam gives the dough a big oven spring.
A dense gummy crumb usually means the dough was underproofed. Let the bulk ferment go until the dough has risen about fifty percent.
Cutting the bread while it is hot also makes the crumb gummy. Wait at least an hour so the starches can set.
Use the poke test. If the dent springs back slowly and only partly, the dough is ready to bake.
After you call setCount the variable does not change right away. It keeps the old value until the next render.
Inside a timer callback you might read a stale value from an old render. Pass a function to the setter to update from the latest state.
Never mutate an array in state with push. Create a new array so React notices the change and re renders.
If your effect sets state and has no dependency array, it runs after every render and creates an infinite loop.
Objects created during render are new every time, so putting them in the dependency array makes the effect run again and again.
Return a cleanup function to cancel the fetch with an AbortController when the component unmounts.
Server components run only on the server, so they can read from the database directly and send no JavaScript to the browser.
You cannot use useState or event handlers in a server component. Mark interactive parts with the use client directive.
Because less JavaScript ships to the browser, pages built with server components can load noticeably faster.
Start with a bloom. Pour about twice the coffee weight in water and wait forty five seconds so the gas can escape.
Pour in slow spirals and keep the water level steady. A total brew time around three minutes is a good target.
If the coffee tastes sour, grind finer. If it tastes bitter and dry, grind coarser.
Use eighteen grams of coffee and aim for about thirty six grams of espresso in the cup. That is a one to two ratio.
If the shot runs faster than twenty five seconds it will taste sour. Make the grind finer to slow it down.
Channeling happens when water finds a weak spot in the puck. Distribute the grounds evenly before you tamp.
Use a coarse grind and a ratio of one part coffee to eight parts cold water. Steep it in the fridge for sixteen hours.
Cold brew tastes smoother and less acidic because hot water extracts more of the sharp compounds.
Strain it through a paper filter and keep the concentrate in the fridge for up to two weeks.
Most of your miles should be easy enough that you can hold a conversation. Only about one day a week should be hard.
Build your long run gradually until it reaches about twenty miles, three weeks before race day.
Practice taking energy gels during long runs so your stomach is used to them on race day.
Shin splints usually come from increasing mileage too quickly. Add no more than ten percent per week.
Strengthen your calves with slow heel raises. Strong calves absorb impact that would otherwise hit the shin bone.
Ice the sore area after runs and switch to cycling for a week if the pain gets sharp.
Super shoes combine a stiff carbon fiber plate with a bouncy foam. Studies found they save about four percent of energy.
The foam wears out faster than regular trainers, so save them for races and fast workouts.
Beginners running slower paces get a smaller benefit, so a normal cushioned shoe is fine for easy runs.
Direct air capture machines use giant fans to push air over a filter that grabs carbon dioxide.
In Iceland the captured gas is dissolved in water and injected into basalt, where it turns into stone within two years.
Right now removing a ton this way costs several hundred dollars, which is far too expensive at scale.
Young trees absorb very little carbon. It takes decades of growth before a forest stores large amounts.
Planting the wrong species in grasslands can harm the ecosystem and even reduce how much carbon the soil holds.
If a planted forest burns down in a wildfire, the stored carbon goes straight back into the atmosphere.
Adding crushed minerals like olivine to seawater raises its alkalinity, so the ocean can absorb more carbon dioxide.
Growing kelp and sinking it to the deep sea is another idea, but measuring how much carbon stays down is hard.
Scientists worry about side effects on plankton, so trials so far have been small.
An index fund simply buys every company in an index like the S and P five hundred instead of picking stocks.
Look at the expense ratio. A fund charging one percent a year can cost you tens of thousands over decades compared with one charging point zero three.
Most actively managed funds fail to beat their index after fees over fifteen years.
Payment history is the biggest factor. One payment that is thirty days late can stay on your report for seven years.
Keep your credit utilization under thirty percent. Using less of your available limit raises your score.
Do not close your oldest card, because the length of your credit history also matters.
With a Roth you pay tax now and withdraw tax free in retirement. With a traditional account you get the deduction today.
If you expect to be in a higher tax bracket later, the Roth usually wins.
Roth contributions, but not the earnings, can be withdrawn at any time without penalty.
Roman builders mixed volcanic ash with lime. In seawater the mixture grows new minerals that make harbor walls stronger over time.
Researchers found small white chunks called lime clasts that heal cracks when water seeps in.
Modern concrete cracks and its steel rebar rusts, which is why our piers rarely last a century.
Aqueducts used only gravity. The channel dropped a few centimeters every hundred meters over many kilometers.
Most of an aqueduct actually ran underground. The famous arches were only needed to cross valleys.
Water reached public fountains and bathhouses first, and wealthy homes paid for private pipes made of lead.
Emperors paid soldiers by minting more coins with less silver in them. The denarius eventually held almost no silver.
Prices soared, so Diocletian issued an edict fixing maximum prices, which led to shortages and black markets.
Historians still argue whether money troubles caused the collapse or were just a symptom of deeper problems.
Roll your index finger slightly onto its bony side. The flat fleshy part tends to mute the strings.
Use the weight of your arm pulling back instead of squeezing with your thumb. That saves your hand from cramping.
Start with the F chord near the fifth fret where the string tension is lower, then move toward the nut.
Push the bridge pins out with the notch in a string winder. Remove the old strings one at a time to keep tension on the neck.
Leave about two inches of slack past the tuning post so you get two or three wraps around it.
New strings stretch a lot. Gently pull each one away from the fretboard and retune several times.
Your thumb alternates between two bass strings on every beat, like a steady heartbeat.
Your index and middle fingers pluck the higher strings in between the thumb notes, which creates the rolling pattern.
Practice the thumb alone until it is automatic before adding the fingers, or the rhythm falls apart.
Warm the engine for a few minutes so the oil drains faster, then remove the drain plug with the right size wrench.
Rub a little fresh oil on the rubber gasket of the new filter and tighten it by hand only.
Take the old oil to an auto parts store. Pouring it down a drain is illegal and pollutes groundwater.
Many pads have a small metal tab called a wear indicator that squeals against the rotor when the pad is nearly gone.
A grinding noise means metal on metal. The rotor is being damaged and needs replacement soon.
Bed in new pads with several firm stops from moderate speed so material transfers evenly to the rotor.
Rotate your tires every five thousand miles so the front and rear wear evenly.
Check pressure when the tires are cold. The correct number is on a sticker inside the driver door, not on the tire.
Put a penny in the tread with the head upside down. If you can see the whole head, it is time for new tires.
